#image("/imgs/ap-calc-bc-2016-frq-02-diagram-01.jpg", width: 65%)

At time $t$, the position of a particle moving in the $x y$-plane is given by the parametric functions $(x(t)\, y(t))$, where $frac(d x,d t)= t^(2)+ sin lr((3 t^(2)))$. The graph of $y$, consisting of three line segments, is shown in the figure above. At $t = 0$, the particle is at position $(5 \,1)$.

(a) Find the position of the particle at $t = 3$.

(b) Find the slope of the line tangent to the path of the particle at $t = 3$.

(c) Find the speed of the particle at $t = 3$.

(d) Find the total distance traveled by the particle from $t = 0$ to $t = 2$.
